environment: Headless Chromium on Linux with SwiftShader software rendering
delivery: Local file viewer with bundled Three.js and embedded exported GLB bytes
checks: Timeline scrub updates displayed time and actual head/hand world poses.
Play advances time; Pause stops playback.
Release playback matches the free sphere and stopped carrier at 1.5 seconds.
Endpoint keeps the carrier stopped and the sphere below the reference grid.
Object selection displays the selected object’s decoded world coordinates.
Helper, path, and grid controls can be toggled.
Save GLB downloads the exact checked-in exported artifact.
Narrow 720-pixel layout has no horizontal overflow.
A local import plays without inheriting the built-in demo’s conformance claim or source.
No page JavaScript errors or network requests during file-based playback.
limits: Screenshots and functional checks are bounded evidence for these demonstrations.
